title: AI Calorie, Heart Rate Tracker — Everyday Wellness, Connected
introduction: An Android wellness app bringing AI meal logging, heart rate tracking, hydration goals and eye-rest reminders into one daily experience.
about: AI Calorie, Heart Rate Tracker supports everyday self-tracking through meal entries, heart rate records, hydration tracking and eye-rest activity.
The experience brings these routines together so users can review their day without moving between separate tools. It is intended for general wellness, not medical diagnosis or treatment.
challenge: The design problem is balancing a useful overview with focused individual tasks. Someone logging a meal has a different immediate goal from someone reviewing a heart rate entry or recording a glass of water. Each journey needs a clear starting point without making the home screen feel crowded.

Different measurements also require different visual treatment. A daily total, a single reading and a completed activity should remain easy to distinguish. Consistent navigation can connect these experiences while clear labels preserve their individual meaning.

Trust is another important consideration. The interface should explain what each feature records and avoid presenting general wellness information as a clinical conclusion. Helpful guidance should support users without overwhelming the task they came to complete.
